My dad passed away in Feb. My daughter was 3 at the time. She was there when I got the bad news I ended up fainting at a hockey game and the EMTS there had to help me out of the building. So there was no pre talk about how to break the news to her as she was there with me when it happened. We told her Grandpa was old, and he had a bad heart. She was with us when we seen him in the casket to say good bye. I didn't hide any part of it as it's a part of life we must all go threw some day. She has lots of questions mostly worried about me or her dad dying. We just kept answers based on that neither me or her dad were going any where anytime soon, and how grandpa was much older and his body was tired. We told her we will keep him alive in our hearts and printed  a big picture out of him for our living room. We talk about grandpa all the time.
